sql: SELECT diagnosis_code, COUNT(*) AS encounters FROM clinical.encounters GROUP BY diagnosis_code
SELECT encounter_id, diagnosis_code, cost FROM clinical.encounters WHERE encounter_date >= '2026-01-01'
SELECT provider_id, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM clinical.encounters WHERE diagnosis_code LIKE 'E11%' GROUP BY provider_id
SELECT provider_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM clinical.encounters GROUP BY provider_id
